bullets.text: The Principal Sessions Court in Tiruvallur sentenced a man to life imprisonment for raping and attempting to murder a woman in Pulicat, and the office should monitor public safety updates.
Minister for Cooperatives V. Gandhiraj flagged off the crushing of over two lakh tonnes of sugarcane at Tiruttani Cooperative Sugarmills, and the office should watch agricultural output developments.

stories.title: Man gets life for rape, murder attempt in Pulicat
takeaways: The Principal Sessions Court in Tiruvallur sentenced a man to life imprisonment for a 2021 rape and murder attempt in Pulicat.
The ruling highlights local judiciary action against violent crimes within the Thiruvallur district jurisdiction.

stories.title: Crushing begins at Tiruttani Cooperative Sugarmills
takeaways: Minister for Cooperatives V. Gandhiraj inaugurated the sugarcane crushing at the Tiruttani Cooperative Sugarmills.
Over two lakh tonnes of sugarcane from 1,767 farmers will be processed during the 2025-27 season.
